baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause on the judgment root at word 6 and the relational locative at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken summons directs disputants to delegated adjudication; judgment both decides and restrains injury within the relation joining the parties.

activation_trace.role: A vocal call that inclines its hearer supplies entry into the shared forum.
A carried message and its bearer supply delegated communicative authority.
Restraint that blocks corruption gives judging a corrective function.
Interpersonal adjudication supplies the explicit deciding operation.
A standing connection between parties makes the intervening space a relation to preserve or repair.

changed_reading.before: They are invited to have a dispute decided.
changed_reading.after: They are summoned into a restraining, repair-oriented adjudication operating inside their shared relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second suddenness construction, the faction noun at word 9, and the active turning noun at word 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call opens a common relational space, but a piece of the parties detaches and bodily presents its side; the repeated suddenness marker stages refusal as an event of procedural rupture.

activation_trace.role: Separation after connection supplies the risk built into the shared forum.
A detached group or small separated piece gives the faction event-like geometry.
Turning while showing one's side makes refusal visible as directed bodily withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: Some of them refuse to participate.
changed_reading.after: At the instant a common forum is opened, a detached piece converts relational difference into a visible exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated clarification, witness, and established-truth sequences recast adjudication as an epistemic operation: it separates claims by making what lies between the parties demonstrable.

activation_trace.role: Judgment between people remains the focus operation being revised.
Disclosure and visible distinction make the focus locative an evidentiary interface.
The surah opens with signs characterized by manifest clarity, setting a disclosure frame.
Witnessing as knowledgeable declaration supplies the procedure for testing contested speech.
Truth made established and visible supplies the endpoint of adjudicative disclosure.

structural_cues: The ordered movement from clear signs through accusation and witness rules to manifest truth repeatedly couples legal decision with making claims inspectable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarification, knowledgeable witnesses, and manifested truth; I infer that the focus judgment performs the same disclosure-and-sorting operation. A live alternative is that these are parallel legal themes and the focus means only issuance of a verdict.

changed_reading.before: The judge chooses between two sides.
changed_reading.after: The judgment opens the contested interval, tests speech against witness, and makes the true distinction visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence supplies three responses to authority: proclaimed obedience followed by turning, eager submission when the right belongs to the claimant, and hearing that becomes willing compliance. The focus refusal is therefore an outcome-contingent break in a reception-to-action circuit.

activation_trace.role: The call supplies the common input whose different responses expose allegiance.
Visible turning away marks the failed completion of the response.
Turning one's back after a verbal pledge supplies the mismatch between profession and conduct.
A right specifically possessed by a party identifies the favorable-outcome condition.
Ready submission supplies the contrasting response when self-interest is served.
Hearing that includes understanding and compliance supplies successful reception.
Making the self easy for an order supplies the volitional completion of hearing.

structural_cues: Verses 24:47-51 surround the focus with a prior failed pledge, a favorable-right exception, and an almost exact positive replay of the summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched summonses and sharply different motion and speech responses; I infer that outcome preference controls whether hearing becomes self-yielding. A live alternative is simple hypocrisy without a specifically procedural compliance mechanism.

changed_reading.after: They recognize and approach the forum selectively, completing obedience only when judgment is likely to secure their own claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah voices fear that the judge may incline unfairly, while the focus already locates the visible lateral motion in the claimants themselves. The feared tilt is projected onto the forum; the enacted tilt is their departure from its middle.

activation_trace.role: The interval or middle between parties supplies the spatial center of adjudication.
The side or lateral aspect supplies the geometry of their own displacement.
Turning while exposing the side makes that displacement an enacted refusal.
The heart supplies the interior site from which the projected concern arises.
Agitated doubt destabilizes trust in the forum.
Anticipation of harm supplies the motive assigned to their withdrawal.
Inclination within judgment names the bias they fear and completes the spatial reversal.

structural_cues: The interrogative series in 24:50 follows the turning scene and culminates in the possibility of judicial inclination before reversing the charge onto the claimants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a central between-space, their side-turn, and their fear of judicial inclination; I infer a reversal in which they project their own lateral departure onto the judge. A live alternative is that the fear is merely listed and not spatially mirrored.

changed_reading.before: They leave because they distrust the verdict.
changed_reading.after: They imagine the adjudicative center will tilt against them, yet their own lateral exit is the asymmetry the passage exposes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier false-accusation sequence shows a mutually supporting group receiving speech tongue-to-tongue until it spreads. This makes the focus faction a coalition produced and maintained by circulation; neutral adjudication threatens the network that holds its account together.

activation_trace.role: A detached human group supplies the focus coalition to be socially thickened.
A group encircling and supporting one another supplies coalition cohesion.
Receiving and passing on speech supplies the transmission link.
The speaking organ supplies the embodied relay through which the claim moves.
Diffusion and dispersal supply the scale-up from relay to public circulation.

structural_cues: Verses 24:11-19 move from a supporting group, through mouth-to-mouth reception, to the social spread of a damaging claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coalition, relay, and diffusion; I infer that circulated speech binds the focus faction and makes its withdrawal coordinated. A live alternative is that the faction is a pre-existing subset unrelated to the earlier rumor mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing subset happens to turn away.
changed_reading.after: A speech-bound coalition withdraws together because adjudication would break the circulation that sustains its shared claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly regulates access and departure by permission, culminating in a common affair where believers request leave and others slip away under cover. The focus call opens an authorized shared forum; turning away refuses that forum without recognized release.

activation_trace.role: The summons supplies authorized entry into a shared proceeding.
The connection between parties supplies the common space from which departure matters.
The faction's side-turn supplies unrecognized exit from that space.
An affair or occasion that gathers people supplies the collective procedural setting.
Permission and licensed action supply the legitimate departure protocol.
The contrast between the messenger's call and ordinary mutual calls marks unequal summons authority.
Slipping out supplies the covert counterpart to the focus's overt withdrawal.
Using another as cover supplies the concealment mechanism of unauthorized exit.

structural_cues: House-entry rules in 24:27-29 and 24:58-59 develop into permission to leave a common affair in 24:62 and covert departure after the messenger's call in 24:63.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies regulated thresholds, licensed leave, a common affair, and covert exit; I infer that the focus summons constitutes an authorized forum whose refusal is procedurally meaningful. A live alternative is that household and assembly permissions do not govern the adjudication scene analogically.

changed_reading.before: They decline an invitation to court.
changed_reading.after: They exit an authorized common proceeding as though its summons required no acknowledged leave, anticipating the later pattern of slipping away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Other ordered movements in the surah are ethically required: pardon turns a page or side from injury, denied visitors return, and gazes are lowered. The focus does not condemn withdrawal as motion in itself; it condemns withdrawal from the mechanism that restrains injustice.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side supplies the focal withdrawal whose ethical direction must be assessed.
Beautifully turning from an offense supplies a sanctioned form of disengagement.
Returning when entry is denied supplies rule-governed retreat from a threshold.
Lowering and restraining direction supplies protective self-withdrawal.

structural_cues: The sequence from pardon through household access to gaze regulation repeatedly distinguishes commanded redirection from invasive or evasive movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several approved forms of turning or restraint; I infer that direction and object, not withdrawal alone, determine the focus act's fault. A live alternative is that these commands are ethically separate and provide no contrastive gloss on the focus.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is inherently the condemned act.
changed_reading.after: Withdrawal can protect others or honor boundaries; this withdrawal is blameworthy because it abandons the forum meant to prevent injustice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a different branch of the same root color the active turning noun. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the surah's explicit transient-gain occurrence plus the favorable-right response; render it as a possible resonance of self-interest, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The active turning noun at word 11 carries the same root used for transient worldly goods in 24:33.

activation_trace.role: Turning while showing the side remains the direct focus sense.
A transient worldly good supplies the possible gain-oriented undertone.
A right owned by the claimant ties approach to favorable possession and makes the undertone functional.

changed_reading.before: They turn away without a specified incentive.
changed_reading.after: Their side-turn may also resonate with orientation toward transient gain: they approach adjudication when the possessed right is theirs and evade it otherwise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material bridle branch of the judgment root and the difficult-sideways-motion branch of the turning root. Both are focus-root anchored and the path sequence supplies motion cues; render it only as a mechanical analogy for corrective governance, never as the lexical meaning of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The judgment verb at word 6 and the turning noun at word 11 support a restraint-versus-veering mechanism.

activation_trace.role: A bridle surrounding the jaws supplies controlled restraint of forward motion.
Sideways, hard-to-straighten travel supplies the faction's veering response.
Following trace after trace supplies path-dependent movement.
Footprints followed by a traveler supply the incremental route.
A straight road supplies the stated directional norm immediately before the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: Judgment is a static verdict opposed by refusal.
changed_reading.after: Judgment can be carried as a rein-like correction of path-dependent motion, while the faction resists by veering sideways from the straight route.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a meteorological sequence is mapped onto a legal-social scene. It remains anchored in the focus's between, faction, and turning roots and uses the packet's explicit joining-between-diversion sequence; render it as a material analogy for assembly and dispersal, not as semantic equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The intervening relation at word 7, detached group at word 9, and directional turn at word 11 form a gather-or-disperse geometry.

activation_trace.role: A connection standing between parties supplies the social join.
A detached piece supplies the break from the gathered whole.
Turning aside supplies diversion from the joining process.
Joining one thing to another supplies coalescence.
Connection in the interval supplies the exact relational hinge of that coalescence.
Accumulation part over part supplies a formed collective.
Diversion away from a face supplies the counter-movement to gathering.

changed_reading.before: The forum merely places already formed parties opposite each other.
changed_reading.after: The call attempts to coalesce parties through their shared interval; the faction becomes a detached piece by diverting itself from that forming relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates affective and medical branches of the faction root rather than the noun's ordinary collective sense. It remains unusually well anchored because 24:50 explicitly supplies heart, illness, and fear; render it as diagnostic root resonance, not as a lexical substitution for faction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The faction noun at word 9 carries branches of heart-scattering fear and separation from illness.

activation_trace.role: Fear that disperses the heart supplies an interior analogue for outward factional division.
Parting from illness supplies a latent convalescent alternative that the refused judgment might have enabled.
The heart supplies the explicit interior site of the diagnostic reading.
Departure from health and balance supplies the condition needing correction.
Fear of expected harm supplies the force that scatters the interior and externalizes as faction.

changed_reading.before: The faction is only a social subset.
changed_reading.after: The social split may externalize a heart scattered by fear, while the refused adjudication also appears as a missed route out of diseased imbalance.

strongest_changes: The matched summons in 24:48 and 24:51 turns refusal into an outcome-sensitive break between hearing and willing compliance.
The fear of judicial inclination in 24:50 reverses spatially onto the claimants' own side-turn away from the between-space.
Evidence, permission, and collective-exit sequences make the focus forum simultaneously truth-disclosing, authorized, and socially binding.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made directional and procedural mechanisms unusually dense: speech becomes evidence, relational middles become sites of disclosure, and turning is calibrated against legitimate pardon, retreat, and permission. The branch inventories also supported contained material readings of bridling, cloud coalescence, transient gain, and fear-scattered illness.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the transient-gain echo in the turning root is rhetorically active or only a productive branch activation.
Whether the bridle and cloud mechanisms should remain private analytical analogies rather than enter downstream prose.
Whether the faction is chiefly a pre-existing interest group or one produced by circulating speech and fear at the moment of judgment.
